title: The Book of 2 Corinthians Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 2 Corinthians — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
verses.decoded: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, and our brother Timothy, send greetings to the church of God in Corinth, along with all the believers throughout Achaia.

verses.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: May you receive grace and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
verses.decoded: Praise be to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father full of mercy and the God who comforts us in every situation.

verses.kjv: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
verses.decoded: He comforts us in all our troubles so that we can comfort others who are going through difficulties, using the same comfort God has given us.

verses.kjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
verses.decoded: Just as we experience many sufferings because of Christ, we also receive abundant comfort through Christ.

verses.kjv: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
verses.decoded: Whether we suffer or are comforted, it is for your encouragement and salvation, helping you endure the same sufferings we endure.

verses.kjv: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
verses.decoded: We have a strong hope in you, knowing that just as you share in our sufferings, you will also share in our comfort.

verses.kjv: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, we don’t want you to be unaware of the hardships we faced in Asia, where we were overwhelmed beyond our strength and even lost hope of survival.

verses.kjv: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
verses.decoded: We felt as if we were sentenced to death so that we would stop relying on ourselves and instead trust in God, who raises the dead.

verses.kjv: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
verses.decoded: God has rescued us from such a deadly situation and continues to rescue us; we trust that He will rescue us again.

verses.kjv: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
verses.decoded: You also help us by praying for us, so that many people may give thanks on our behalf for the blessing we have received through many.

verses.kjv: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
verses.decoded: What makes us happy is that our conscience assures us we have lived with honesty and sincere devotion—not using worldly wisdom, but by God’s grace—both in general and especially toward you.

verses.kjv: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
verses.decoded: We don’t write anything to you that you don’t already know or accept, and I am confident you will continue to accept it fully.

verses.kjv: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.decoded: Just as you have accepted us in part and we bring you joy, so you will be our joy on the day the Lord Jesus returns.

verses.kjv: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
verses.decoded: With this confidence, I planned to visit you earlier so you could have a second blessing.

verses.kjv: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judæa.
verses.decoded: I planned to visit you on my way to Macedonia, then return from Macedonia to visit you again, and finally have you accompany me on my journey to Judea.

verses.kjv: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
verses.decoded: So when I made these plans, was I acting carelessly? Do I make my decisions based on human feelings so that I say yes one moment and no the next?

verses.kjv: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
verses.decoded: But since God is faithful, the message we gave you was not uncertain or contradictory.

verses.kjv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
verses.decoded: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, whom we preached to you—including me, Silas, and Timothy—was not a message of uncertainty; in Him everything is certain.

verses.kjv: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
verses.decoded: All of God's promises find their fulfillment in Christ, and through Him we say 'Amen'—meaning 'so be it'—to God's glory.

verses.kjv: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
verses.decoded: It is God who strengthens us together with you in Christ and has anointed us,

verses.kjv: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.decoded: who has also marked us with His seal and given us the Holy Spirit as a guarantee in our hearts.

verses.kjv: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
verses.decoded: I swear by God that I have not yet visited Corinth to avoid causing you pain.

verses.kjv: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
verses.decoded: We do not control your faith; rather, we help you find joy, because it is by your faith that you stand firm.

verses.kjv: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
verses.decoded: I decided that I would not come back to you feeling sad or burdened.

verses.kjv: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
verses.decoded: If I cause you sadness, then who will make me happy except the one I made sad?

verses.kjv: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
verses.decoded: I wrote this to you so that I wouldn’t be sad when I visit those I should be happy about. I trust all of you, because your joy is also my joy.

verses.kjv: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
verses.decoded: I wrote to you with great pain and many tears, not to make you sad, but to show you how deeply I love you.

verses.kjv: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
verses.decoded: If anyone caused sadness, it only upset me a little, so I don’t overwhelm all of you with blame.

verses.kjv: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
verses.decoded: The punishment given by many is enough for that person.

verses.kjv: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
verses.decoded: Instead, you should forgive and comfort him, so he isn’t overwhelmed by too much sadness.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I ask you to show your love to him firmly.

verses.kjv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
verses.decoded: I wrote to test you and see if you would obey in everything.

verses.kjv: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
verses.decoded: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive them. And if I have forgiven anyone, I did so for your sake, in the presence of Christ.

verses.kjv: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
verses.decoded: We must forgive so Satan doesn’t take advantage of us, because we know his tricks.

verses.kjv: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
verses.decoded: When I arrived in Troas to preach the gospel of Christ, the Lord opened a door of opportunity for me.

verses.kjv: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
verses.decoded: I was troubled because I couldn’t find Titus, so after saying goodbye, I left for Macedonia.

verses.kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
verses.decoded: Thanks be to God, who always leads us to victory in Christ and makes the knowledge of Him known everywhere through us.

verses.kjv: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
verses.decoded: We are like a pleasing fragrance to God, both to those who are being saved and to those who are perishing.

verses.kjv: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
verses.decoded: To some, we are like a smell that brings death leading to death; to others, we are like a smell that brings life leading to life. Who is truly able to handle this?

verses.kjv: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
verses.decoded: We are not like many who twist God's word for their own gain. Instead, we speak honestly, as people sent by God, and we speak in Christ's presence before God.

verses.kjv: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
verses.decoded: Are we starting over by praising ourselves? Or do we need letters of recommendation to you, like some others do, or letters from you to recommend us?

verses.kjv: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
verses.decoded: You yourselves are like a letter written in our hearts, known and read by everyone.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
verses.decoded: You clearly show that you are a letter from Christ, sent through us, written not with ink but by the Spirit of the living God; not on stone tablets, but on human hearts.

verses.kjv: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
verses.decoded: We have this kind of confidence before God because of Christ.

verses.kjv: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
verses.decoded: It’s not that we are capable on our own to think anything as coming from ourselves; rather, our ability comes from God.

verses.kjv: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
verses.decoded: He has made us competent as ministers of the new covenant—not of the written law, but of the Spirit. The written law brings death, but the Spirit gives life.

verses.kjv: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
verses.decoded: If the ministry that brings death, which was engraved on stone tablets, was glorious—so much that the Israelites couldn’t look steadily at Moses’ face because of its glory, a glory that was fading away—

verses.kjv: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
verses.decoded: How much more glorious will be the ministry of the Spirit?

verses.kjv: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
verses.decoded: If the ministry that brings condemnation was glorious, then the ministry that brings righteousness is even more glorious.

verses.kjv: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
verses.decoded: For even what was made glorious had no real glory compared to the greater glory.

verses.kjv: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
verses.decoded: If what was temporary was glorious, how much more glorious is what lasts forever!

verses.kjv: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
verses.decoded: Since we have this hope, we speak very boldly.

verses.kjv: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
verses.decoded: We are not like Moses, who put a veil over his face so the Israelites couldn’t look steadily at the end of what was fading away.

verses.kjv: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
verses.decoded: But their minds were hardened; even today, the same veil remains when they read the old covenant, and it is not removed because it is only removed in Christ.

verses.kjv: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
verses.decoded: Even today, when they read Moses, a veil covers their hearts.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
verses.decoded: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil covering their heart will be removed.

verses.kjv: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
verses.decoded: The Lord is the Spirit, and wherever the Spirit of the Lord is present, there is freedom.

verses.kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But all of us, with uncovered faces, reflecting the Lord’s glory like a mirror, are being transformed into His image, growing more like Him from one degree of glory to the next, by the power of the Lord’s Spirit.

verses.kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
verses.decoded: Since we have this ministry because we have been shown mercy, we do not give up;

verses.kjv: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
verses.decoded: Instead, we have rejected secret ways of wrongdoing, not using trickery or twisting God's word, but openly telling the truth and appealing to everyone's conscience before God.

verses.kjv: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
verses.decoded: If the good news we preach is hidden, it is hidden only to those who are spiritually lost;

verses.kjv: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
verses.decoded: because the ruler of this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers so they cannot see the glorious light of the gospel of Christ, who reflects God's image.

verses.kjv: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus’ sake.
verses.decoded: We do not preach about ourselves, but about Christ Jesus as Lord; and we serve you for Jesus’ sake.

verses.kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: God, who made light shine out of darkness, has shone in our hearts to give us the knowledge of God’s glory seen in Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
verses.decoded: We carry this precious treasure in fragile human bodies so that God’s power, not ours, is clearly seen.

verses.kjv: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
verses.decoded: We face troubles everywhere, but we are not crushed; we are confused, but not hopeless;

verses.kjv: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
verses.decoded: We are persecuted, but God does not abandon us; we are knocked down, but not destroyed;

verses.kjv: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
verses.decoded: We constantly carry in our bodies the death of Jesus so that His life may also be revealed in us.

verses.kjv: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
verses.decoded: As long as we live, we face death for Jesus’ sake so that His life may be shown in our mortal bodies.

verses.kjv: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
verses.decoded: So death is at work in us, but it brings life to you.

verses.kjv: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
verses.decoded: We have the same spirit of faith as the scripture says: 'I believed, so I spoke.' We also believe and therefore speak.

verses.kjv: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
verses.decoded: We know that the one who raised Jesus will also raise us and bring us together with you through Jesus.

verses.kjv: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
verses.decoded: Everything is done for your benefit, so that God’s abundant grace, through many thankful hearts, will bring Him glory.

verses.kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
verses.decoded: Therefore, we do not give up. Even though our physical bodies are wasting away, our inner selves are being renewed every day.

verses.kjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
verses.decoded: Our troubles, which are small and temporary, are producing for us an incredibly great and eternal glory.

verses.kjv: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.decoded: We focus not on what is visible, but on what is invisible, because what we see is temporary, but what we cannot see is eternal.

verses.kjv: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.decoded: We know that if our earthly body is destroyed, we have a permanent home from God, a heavenly body not made by human hands, eternal in heaven.

verses.kjv: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
verses.decoded: Because of this, we long and eagerly wait to be given our heavenly bodies.

verses.kjv: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
verses.decoded: We hope that when we receive these heavenly bodies, we will not be found without them.

verses.kjv: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
verses.decoded: While we live in these earthly bodies, we groan because we are burdened—not wanting to be without a body, but to be clothed with a new one so that death is overcome by life.

verses.kjv: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
verses.decoded: God, who prepared us for this, has given us the Holy Spirit as a guarantee of what is to come.

verses.kjv: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
verses.decoded: So we are always confident, knowing that while we live in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.

verses.kjv: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
verses.decoded: Because we live by faith and not by what we see.

verses.kjv: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
verses.decoded: We are confident and would prefer to leave our bodies and be with the Lord.

verses.kjv: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
verses.decoded: So we work hard to please God, whether we are living or have died.

verses.kjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
verses.decoded: For we will all stand before Christ’s judgment seat to receive what we deserve for what we have done in our bodies, whether good or bad.

verses.kjv: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
verses.decoded: Because we respect the Lord’s authority, we try to convince others; we are clear before God, and I hope also clear in your minds.

verses.kjv: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
verses.decoded: We don’t need to recommend ourselves to you again, but want you to have something to say to those who boast only in outward appearances, not in true character.

verses.kjv: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
verses.decoded: Whether we seem crazy or sane, it is for God’s sake; whether we are clear-headed, it is for your benefit.

verses.kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
verses.decoded: Christ’s love controls us because we believe that if one died for everyone, then everyone died with Him.

verses.kjv: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
verses.decoded: And He died for everyone so that those who live should no longer live for themselves but for Christ who died and rose again for them.

verses.kjv: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
verses.decoded: So from now on, we no longer view anyone merely by their human nature. Even though we once knew Christ in a purely human way, we do not know him like that anymore.

verses.kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verses.decoded: So if anyone belongs to Christ, they are a new person. The old life is gone, and everything has become fresh and new.

verses.kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.decoded: Everything comes from God, who has brought us back to Himself through Jesus Christ and has given us the responsibility to help others be reconciled to Him.

verses.kjv: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
verses.decoded: This means that God was in Christ, restoring the world to Himself by not holding people's sins against them, and He has given us the message of reconciliation to share.

verses.kjv: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.
verses.decoded: So we are representatives of Christ, as if God Himself is appealing to you through us. We urge you on Christ’s behalf: be reconciled to God.

verses.kjv: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
verses.decoded: God made Christ, who was sinless, take on our sin so that we could be made right with God through Him.

verses.kjv: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
verses.decoded: As partners working with God, we urge you not to let God's grace be wasted on you.

verses.kjv: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
verses.decoded: For God says, 'I have listened to you at the right time; on the day of salvation I helped you.' Look, now is the right time; now is the day of salvation.

verses.kjv: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
verses.decoded: We do everything without causing offense, so that our ministry will not be criticized.

verses.kjv: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
verses.decoded: Instead, we prove ourselves to be God’s servants by showing patience in many troubles and hardships.

verses.kjv: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
verses.decoded: We endure beatings, imprisonment, riots, hard work, sleepless nights, and fasting.

verses.kjv: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
verses.decoded: We serve with purity, wisdom, patience, kindness, the Holy Spirit, and sincere love.

verses.kjv: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.decoded: We rely on the truth of God’s message, His power, and the protection of righteousness on every side.

verses.kjv: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
verses.decoded: We experience both respect and disrespect, bad and good reputations; we may be seen as liars, yet we are truthful.

verses.kjv: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
verses.decoded: We are sometimes ignored but also recognized; we face death but continue living; we are punished but not destroyed.

verses.kjv: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
verses.decoded: We are sad but always joyful; poor but enriching many; having nothing, yet owning everything.

verses.kjv: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
verses.decoded: Dear Corinthians, we speak openly to you and our hearts are wide open.

verses.kjv: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
verses.decoded: You are not restricting us; rather, you are restricting yourselves.

verses.kjv: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
verses.decoded: Now, as a response—and I say this as a father to his children—be open and generous as well.

verses.kjv: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
verses.decoded: Don’t team up closely with unbelievers; what can righteousness have in common with wickedness? What can light share with darkness?

verses.kjv: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
verses.decoded: What harmony is there between Christ and Satan? What agreement can a believer have with an unbeliever?

verses.kjv: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.decoded: What harmony is there between God's temple and idols? You are the temple of the living God. As God said, 'I will live among them and walk with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.'

verses.kjv: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
verses.decoded: Therefore, come out from among them and separate yourselves, says the Lord. Do not touch anything unclean, and I will welcome you.

verses.kjv: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
verses.decoded: I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.

verses.kjv: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
verses.decoded: Since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, striving to be holy because we respect God.

verses.kjv: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
verses.decoded: Accept us; we have not wronged anyone, corrupted anyone, or cheated anyone.

verses.kjv: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
verses.decoded: I’m not saying this to blame you, because I have already told you that you are dear to us, as if we would die or live together with you.

verses.kjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
verses.decoded: I am very confident when I talk to you and proud of you. I am comforted and extremely joyful despite all our troubles.

verses.kjv: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
verses.decoded: When we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest; we were troubled on every side—there were fights outside and fears inside.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
verses.decoded: But God, who comforts those who are discouraged, comforted us by sending Titus to us.

verses.kjv: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
verses.decoded: Not only because Titus came, but also because he was comforted by you when he told us about your eagerness, your sorrow, and your deep concern for me. This made me even happier.

verses.kjv: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
verses.decoded: Even though I made you sad with my letter, I do not regret it—well, I did regret it at first—because I see that the letter made you sad, but only for a little while.

verses.kjv: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
verses.decoded: Now I am glad, not because you were made sad, but because your sadness led to repentance. You were sorry in a godly way so that you suffered no harm from us.

verses.kjv: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
verses.decoded: Godly sorrow leads to repentance and salvation and does not bring regret. But worldly sorrow leads to death.

verses.kjv: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
verses.decoded: See what godly sorrow has done in you: it made you very careful, it made you clear yourselves, it made you angry, afraid, eager, zealous, and ready to take action. In every way, you showed yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
verses.decoded: So even though I wrote to you, it was not for the sake of the one who did wrong or the one who was wronged, but so that you would see how much we care for you before God.

verses.kjv: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
verses.decoded: So we were comforted by your comfort, and we were even happier because Titus was refreshed by all of you.

verses.kjv: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
verses.decoded: If I have praised you to Titus, I am not ashamed. Just as we told you the truth, my praise to Titus has proven true.

verses.kjv: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
verses.decoded: And Titus’ deep affection for you grows even more as he remembers how obedient you all were and how you welcomed him with respect and reverence.

verses.kjv: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
verses.decoded: I am glad because I trust you completely in everything.

verses.kjv: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, we want you to know about the generous grace God has given to the churches in Macedonia;

verses.kjv: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
verses.decoded: Even though they were going through severe troubles and were very poor, their joy was so great that it overflowed into generous giving.

verses.kjv: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
verses.decoded: I can testify that they gave as much as they could, and even more, willingly and voluntarily;

verses.kjv: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
verses.decoded: They begged us earnestly to accept their gift and to share in the work of helping God’s people.

verses.kjv: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
verses.decoded: And they did this even more than we expected, first dedicating themselves to the Lord and then to us, following God’s plan.

verses.kjv: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
verses.decoded: Because of this, we asked Titus to encourage you to complete this same generous work you started earlier.

verses.kjv: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
verses.decoded: Since you excel in faith, speaking, knowledge, hard work, and love for us, make sure you also excel in this generous giving.

verses.kjv: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
verses.decoded: I’m not commanding you, but I’m encouraging you because others have been eager to give, and I want to show that your love is genuine.

verses.kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
verses.decoded: You know how our Lord Jesus Christ was rich, but for your sake he became poor, so that through his poverty you could become spiritually rich.

verses.kjv: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
verses.decoded: Here is my advice: it’s good for you, who started this giving last year, not only to continue but to be eager to complete it now.

verses.kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
verses.decoded: So now, complete what you planned to do, so that your willingness to give is matched by your actual giving.

verses.kjv: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
verses.decoded: If you are willing to give, God accepts it based on what you have, not on what you don’t have.

verses.kjv: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
verses.decoded: I don’t mean that some should be relieved of giving while others are burdened;

verses.kjv: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
verses.decoded: Instead, there should be a balance: your surplus now can help meet their needs, and later their surplus can help meet your needs, so that everyone is equal.

verses.kjv: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
verses.decoded: As the Scripture says, 'The one who gathered much didn’t have too much, and the one who gathered little didn’t have too little.'

verses.kjv: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
verses.decoded: Thank God, who gave Titus the same strong concern and care for you.

verses.kjv: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
verses.decoded: Titus accepted the encouragement willingly and even took the initiative to visit you on his own.

verses.kjv: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
verses.decoded: We also sent along a brother who is well respected and praised in all the churches for his work in the gospel.

verses.kjv: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
verses.decoded: Not only that, but this brother was chosen by the churches to join us in managing this gift, which we handle to honor the Lord and to show your willingness to give.

verses.kjv: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
verses.decoded: We do this carefully so that no one can accuse us of mishandling the generous gift we are managing.

verses.kjv: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.decoded: We make sure everything is done properly, not only to please God but also to be above reproach in the eyes of people.

verses.kjv: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
verses.decoded: We also sent with them a brother who has proven to be hardworking in many ways, and now even more so because of the strong trust I have in you.

verses.kjv: Whether any do inquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be inquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
verses.decoded: If anyone asks about Titus, he is my partner and helper for your benefit; and if they ask about our other brothers, they are representatives of the churches and bring honor to Christ.

verses.kjv: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
verses.decoded: So show them, and all the churches, the evidence of your love and the reason we are proud of you.

verses.kjv: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
verses.decoded: Regarding helping the believers, I don't really need to write to you about it again.

verses.kjv: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
verses.decoded: I know how eager and willing you are, and I have been proud to tell the believers in Macedonia that Achaia was ready to give a year ago. Your enthusiasm has inspired many others.

verses.kjv: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
verses.decoded: But I have sent some brothers to you so that our pride in you won't be empty; as I said, you should be prepared.

verses.kjv: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
verses.decoded: Because if the believers in Macedonia come with me and find you not ready, we (not just you) would be embarrassed by our confident boasting.

verses.kjv: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
verses.decoded: So I urged the brothers to go ahead to you and prepare your gift in advance, which you had already promised, so it will be a willing gift and not something given out of greed.

verses.kjv: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
verses.decoded: Remember this: whoever plants little will harvest little, and whoever plants generously will harvest generously.

verses.kjv: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
verses.decoded: Each person should give what they decide in their heart to give, not reluctantly or because they feel forced, because God loves those who give happily.

verses.kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
verses.decoded: And God can generously provide you with everything you need so that you will always have enough for every good work.

verses.kjv: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
verses.decoded: (As the Scripture says, He has scattered gifts to the poor; his righteousness lasts forever.)

verses.kjv: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
verses.decoded: God, who gives seed to the farmer, will also provide food for you and will increase the seed you have planted and make your righteousness grow.

verses.kjv: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
verses.decoded: You will be enriched in every way so you can be generous on every occasion, which will cause others to thank God because of us.

verses.kjv: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
verses.decoded: This service you are involved in not only meets the needs of the believers but also overflows with many thanks to God.

verses.kjv: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
verses.decoded: Because of this service, they praise God for your obedience to the gospel of Christ and for your generous sharing with them and with everyone else.

verses.kjv: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
verses.decoded: They also pray for you and long to see you because of the wonderful grace God has given you.

verses.kjv: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
verses.decoded: Thank God for his indescribable gift!

verses.kjv: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
verses.decoded: I, Paul, am asking you sincerely, appealing to you by the humility and kindness of Christ. When I am with you, I seem weak and ordinary, but when I am away, I am bold and confident toward you.

verses.kjv: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
verses.decoded: I ask that I may not have to be bold and confident in person as I am when I am away, especially against those who judge us by outward, human standards.

verses.kjv: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
verses.decoded: Even though we live in human bodies, we do not fight using human methods.

verses.kjv: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
verses.decoded: The weapons we use are not physical but have divine power to destroy strongholds and arguments against God.

verses.kjv: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
verses.decoded: We demolish every proud idea and every barrier that opposes knowing God, and we take every thought captive to obey Christ.

verses.kjv: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
verses.decoded: We are prepared to punish all disobedience once your obedience is complete.

verses.kjv: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.
verses.decoded: Do you judge by outward appearances? If anyone is confident that they belong to Christ, they should remember that we belong to Christ just as much as they do.

verses.kjv: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
verses.decoded: Even if I brag more about the authority the Lord gave us to build you up and not tear you down, I would not be ashamed.

verses.kjv: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
verses.decoded: I don’t want you to think I’m trying to scare you with my letters.

verses.kjv: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
verses.decoded: They say my letters are strong and forceful, but when I am with you in person, I seem weak and my speaking is unimpressive.

verses.kjv: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
verses.decoded: Anyone who thinks this way should realize that we will act the same in person as we do in our letters when we are away.

verses.kjv: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
verses.decoded: We don’t dare to compare ourselves with those who praise themselves. But those people compare themselves only with each other and don’t understand what they are doing.

verses.kjv: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
verses.decoded: We won’t brag beyond our limits but only within the limits God has set for us, which extend even to you.

verses.kjv: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
verses.decoded: We don’t go beyond our limits as if we haven’t reached you, because we have preached the gospel to you just as well as to others.

verses.kjv: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
verses.decoded: We don’t boast about work done by others, but we hope that as your faith grows, we will be greatly honored through you according to the authority God has given us.

verses.kjv: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
verses.decoded: I hope to preach the gospel in the areas beyond you, and I do not want to brag about someone else's work that has already been prepared for us.

verses.kjv: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
verses.decoded: But if anyone wants to boast, they should boast only in what the Lord has done.

verses.kjv: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
verses.decoded: It is not the person who praises themselves who is accepted, but the one whom the Lord approves.

verses.kjv: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
verses.decoded: I wish you could tolerate a little of my foolishness; and actually, you do tolerate me.

verses.kjv: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
verses.decoded: I am deeply concerned for you, like a protective husband, because I promised you to one husband—Christ—so I can present you pure and faithful to Him.

verses.kjv: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verses.decoded: But I worry that, just as the serpent deceived Eve with cunning, your thinking might be led away from the pure and simple truth found in Christ.

verses.kjv: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
verses.decoded: If someone comes and preaches a different Jesus than the one we preached, or if you accept a different spirit or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you might be able to tolerate that person.

verses.kjv: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
verses.decoded: I believe I am not in any way inferior to the most respected apostles.

verses.kjv: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
verses.decoded: Even if I am not polished in speaking, I am not lacking in knowledge; and we have clearly shown ourselves to you in every way.

verses.kjv: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
verses.decoded: Have I done wrong by humbling myself so you could be honored, by preaching God’s gospel to you without charging anything?

verses.kjv: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
verses.decoded: I took support from other churches, using their funds to serve you.

verses.kjv: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
verses.decoded: When I was with you and in need, I didn’t ask anyone for help because brothers from Macedonia provided what I lacked; in every way, I have avoided being a burden to you, and I will continue to do so.

verses.kjv: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.decoded: As surely as Christ’s truth lives in me, no one will prevent me from boasting about this in the area of Achaia.

verses.kjv: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
verses.decoded: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows that I do.

verses.kjv: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
verses.decoded: What I do, I will continue to do to remove any chance for those who want to criticize us, so that when they boast, they will be on the same level as we are.

verses.kjv: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
verses.decoded: These people are false apostles, dishonest workers who disguise themselves as apostles of Christ.

verses.kjv: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
verses.decoded: This is not surprising, because even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.

verses.kjv: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
verses.decoded: So it’s no surprise if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness, but their final outcome will be judged by their actions.

verses.kjv: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
verses.decoded: I say again, don’t think of me as a fool; but if you do, then accept me as a fool so I can boast a little.

verses.kjv: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.decoded: What I say now, I’m not saying as a command from the Lord, but I speak like a fool, confidently boasting.

verses.kjv: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
verses.decoded: Since many people boast about worldly things, I will boast too.

verses.kjv: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
verses.decoded: You gladly put up with fools because you think you are wise.

verses.kjv: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
verses.decoded: You allow it when someone enslaves you, takes advantage of you, demands from you, boasts about themselves, or even insults you.

verses.kjv: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
verses.decoded: I’m talking about insults as if we were weak. But wherever anyone is bold—though I may sound foolish—I am bold too.

verses.kjv: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
verses.decoded: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham’s descendants? So am I.

verses.kjv: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
verses.decoded: Are they servants of Christ? (I’m speaking like a fool) I am even more so—working harder, beaten more times than can be counted, imprisoned more often, and nearly killed many times.

verses.kjv: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
verses.decoded: The Jews punished me five times with forty lashes minus one each time.

verses.kjv: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
verses.decoded: I was beaten with rods three times, stoned once, shipwrecked three times, and spent a night and a day adrift at sea.

verses.kjv: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
verses.decoded: I have faced many dangers on travels: from the sea, robbers, my own people, non-believers, in cities, deserts, seas, and even from false brothers.

verses.kjv: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
verses.decoded: I have endured exhaustion and pain, stayed awake many nights, suffered hunger and thirst, fasted often, and been cold and without proper clothes.

verses.kjv: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
verses.decoded: Besides all these external troubles, I have the daily burden of caring for all the churches.

verses.kjv: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
verses.decoded: Who is weak that I am not weak too? Who is hurt that I do not feel deeply?

verses.kjv: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
verses.decoded: If I have to boast, I will boast about my weaknesses.

verses.kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
verses.decoded: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is blessed forever, knows that I am not lying.

verses.kjv: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
verses.decoded: In Damascus, the governor appointed by King Aretas stationed soldiers in the city to try to capture me.

verses.kjv: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verses.decoded: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the city wall and escaped from their grasp.

verses.kjv: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.decoded: I certainly should not boast, but I will talk about visions and revelations from the Lord.

verses.kjv: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
verses.decoded: I know a man in Christ from over fourteen years ago—whether he was in his body or out of it, I don’t know; only God knows—who was taken up to the third heaven.

verses.kjv: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
verses.decoded: I know such a man—whether in the body or apart from the body, I don’t know; only God knows.

verses.kjv: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.decoded: He was taken up into paradise and heard things that cannot be described in words, things no one is allowed to speak about.

verses.kjv: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
verses.decoded: I will boast about this person, but I won’t boast about myself—only about my weaknesses.

verses.kjv: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
verses.decoded: Even if I wanted to boast, I wouldn’t be foolish because I tell the truth. But I’m holding back so no one will think more of me than what they see or hear about me.

verses.kjv: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
verses.decoded: So that I wouldn’t become conceited because of these great revelations, I was given a thorn in my flesh—a messenger from Satan to torment me and keep me humble.

verses.kjv: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
verses.decoded: I pleaded with the Lord three times to take this away from me.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.decoded: But He told me, ‘My grace is enough for you, because my power is strongest when you are weak.’ So I gladly boast about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power can work through me.

verses.kjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.decoded: That’s why I am happy to suffer weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and troubles for Christ’s sake—because when I am weak, I am truly strong.

verses.kjv: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
verses.decoded: I have become foolish by boasting, but you forced me to do it. I should have been praised by you, because I am not inferior to the greatest apostles, even though I am nothing.

verses.kjv: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
verses.decoded: The proof of my apostleship among you is the patience I have shown and the signs, wonders, and miracles I performed.

verses.kjv: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
verses.decoded: What do you lack compared to other churches? Only that I didn’t burden you financially. Please forgive me for this wrong.

verses.kjv: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.decoded: I am ready to visit you for the third time, and I won’t be a burden because I’m not after your money but after you. Children don’t save up for their parents, but parents save for their children.

verses.kjv: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
verses.decoded: I am willing to give everything I have and even give myself up for you, even if the more I love you, the less you love me.

verses.kjv: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
verses.decoded: Even so, I did not put a heavy burden on you; but I admit, I was clever and caught you by trickery.

verses.kjv: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
verses.decoded: Did I take advantage of you through anyone I sent to you?

verses.kjv: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
verses.decoded: I asked Titus to go with a brother I sent. Did Titus take advantage of you? Didn't we all follow the same Spirit and live by the same example?

verses.kjv: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
verses.decoded: Do you think we are trying to justify ourselves to you? We speak honestly before God in Christ. But, dear friends, we do everything for your benefit and growth.

verses.kjv: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
verses.decoded: I am afraid that when I come, I won't find you behaving as I want, and you won't like how I am. I worry there will be arguments, jealousy, anger, fights, gossip, secret slander, pride, and chaos.

verses.kjv: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
verses.decoded: And I fear that when I come again, God will humble me before you, and I will be deeply saddened because many have already sinned and have not turned away from sexual immorality and indecency.

verses.kjv: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
verses.decoded: This is the third time I am coming to you. Every statement must be confirmed by two or three witnesses.

verses.kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
verses.decoded: I warned you before and now, even though I am not with you, I write to those who have sinned earlier and to everyone else: if I come again, I will not hold back.

verses.kjv: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
verses.decoded: Since you want proof that Christ speaks through me, know that His power is not weak toward you but is strong in your lives.

verses.kjv: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
verses.decoded: Though Christ was crucified while appearing weak, He lives by God's power. We are weak in ourselves, but through Him, we will live by God's power directed toward you.

verses.kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
verses.decoded: Test yourselves to see if you are truly living in the faith. Don’t you realize that Jesus Christ lives in you unless you have failed the test?

verses.kjv: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
verses.decoded: But I am confident that you will recognize that we are genuine and not rejected by God.

verses.kjv: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
verses.decoded: I pray to God that you do no wrong—not so that we might look good, but so that you might do what is right, even if we are seen as rejected.

verses.kjv: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
verses.decoded: We can do nothing against the truth; we only act in support of the truth.

verses.kjv: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
verses.decoded: We are happy when we are weak and you are strong. In fact, we want you to be fully restored and mature.

verses.kjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
verses.decoded: That’s why I am writing this while I am away—so that when I come, I won’t have to be harsh. The Lord has given me authority to build you up, not to tear you down.

verses.kjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
verses.decoded: Finally, brothers and sisters, goodbye. Be mature, encourage each other, agree with one another, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

verses.kjv: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
verses.decoded: Greet each other with a holy kiss.

verses.kjv: All the saints salute you.
verses.decoded: All God’s people here send you their greetings.

verses.kjv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
verses.decoded: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
